english.notes:
Byelaw 9 states:-

9(a) Handcarts, mailcarts, metal-tyred vehicles, perambulators, push-carts, wheelbarrows, pedal cycles the riders of which are under the age of 14 years, and vehicles drawn by animals shall not be used in the Queensway Tunnel or on the approaches thereto.

9(b) pedal cycles shall not be used in the Queensway Tunnel during the following period, namely:-
(i) from Monday to Friday inclusive between the hours of 6,00 am and 8.00 pm;
(ii) on Sundays between the hours of 8.00 am and 9.00 pm during the period from 1st April to 30th September inclusive.

9(c) No person shall permit any animal to enter the tunnel except animals conveyed in a vehicle.
